activation_denominator: baseline layer-27 block-output current-token residuals on 12 calibration prompts, sequential KV teacher forcing; k is final prompt token plus every token of the frozen teacher continuation; squared norms accumulated float64
delta_cast_timing: alpha times float64 unit direction, then cast once to BF16 and back to float32 for measurement and injection

root_finding.failure: stop before label-free shell-safety generation; no extrapolation or target change
root_finding.method: deterministic bisection over alpha with BF16-cast amplitude evaluated at every visited point
root_finding.selection: visited alpha with minimum absolute amplitude error; ties choose lower alpha

target_justification: 0.25 and 0.50 span a twofold implemented-amplitude contrast inside the historical label-free V2 safe/manipulation displacement range while remaining below the historical high-dose anchor; no V3 outcome informed them
